# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through GitHub:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/vardius/go-api-boilerplate/security/advisories/new).
Please don't open a public issue, pull request or discussion for it.

Include what an attacker can do, the steps or a test that shows it, and the
commit you tested. You'll get a reply within a week. Once a fix is ready we
publish an advisory and credit you, unless you'd rather not be named.

## Supported versions

Only `master` receives fixes. The `legacy-2022` tag marks the 2022 layout
with the October 2026 security fixes applied; it gets no further changes, so
projects built on it should apply future advisories by hand.

This is a template: code you generated from it is yours to patch. Watch the
repository's security advisories to hear about problems in code you copied.
